entities.summary: The Lenin Boys were the paramilitary of the Hungarian Communist Party operating in Hungarian Soviet Republic in 1919. The group consisted of around 200 men and was commanded by József Cserny. The Lenin Boys were used as an instrument to suppress counter-revolutionary urges against the revolutionary government.
